content:
I've just pushed an update to Theorem Proving in Lean 4. In addition to ensuring that all examples elaborate as expected in 4.20.0-rc3 (even inline ones in paragraphs), there are the following changes:

  • The output of commands is visible in the text, rather than being in comments.

  • Every identifier that's documented in the language reference is a link to the language reference. This is true for most syntax as well, and will become true for all of it soon.

Except as necessary to update the examples, the text remains the same.
